title: Farm Solar Array: irradiance sensor fault (2018-01-17 to 2018-01-22)
summary: Irradiance sensor fault detected at Farm Solar Array (Arbuckle, CA) over 6 day(s), 2018-01-17 to 2018-01-22.
evidence: Irradiance was recorded for only 7% of producing intervals.
The site produced power but the irradiance sensor reported nothing.
recommended_actions: Clean the plane-of-array pyranometer and check its level and tilt alignment
Cross-check its readings against a second on-site sensor or satellite irradiance
Recalibrate or replace the sensor if the offset persists
Treat performance numbers for this window as unreliable until fixed
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.

title: Farm Solar Array: partial outage (2018-04-05 to 2018-04-07)
summary: Partial outage detected at Farm Solar Array (Arbuckle, CA) over 3 day(s), 2018-04-05 to 2018-04-07. Estimated cost so far: $253.
evidence: Performance index fell from 0.99 in the two weeks before to a median of 0.72 during the event (1.00 = healthy).
Estimated energy lost: 2,107 kWh (34% of expected), about $253.
Roughly 33% of capacity appears offline, from the size of the step.
Performance stepped down abruptly and stayed flat, the signature of a share of the array going offline (an inverter, a combiner or a string).
likely_causes: One inverter or inverter module offline
Tripped DC disconnect in one block
recommended_actions: Compare inverter- and combiner-level currents to locate the offline section
Pull inverter fault logs for the start date
Inspect combiner-box fuses and string connectors in the affected block
Run IV-curve traces on suspect strings; replace failed fuses or components
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.

evidence: Performance index fell from 1.01 in the two weeks before to a median of 0.89 during the event (1.00 = healthy).
Estimated energy lost: 2,520 kWh (17% of expected), about $302.
Roughly 16% of capacity appears offline, from the size of the step.
Performance stepped down abruptly and stayed flat, the signature of a share of the array going offline (an inverter, a combiner or a string).
likely_causes: One inverter or inverter module offline
Tripped DC disconnect in one block
recommended_actions: Compare inverter- and combiner-level currents to locate the offline section
Pull inverter fault logs for the start date
Inspect combiner-box fuses and string connectors in the affected block
Run IV-curve traces on suspect strings; replace failed fuses or components
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.

title: Farm Solar Array: irradiance sensor fault (2023-11-02 to 2023-11-09)
summary: Irradiance sensor fault detected at Farm Solar Array (Arbuckle, CA) over 8 day(s), 2023-11-02 to 2023-11-09.
evidence: Irradiance was recorded for only 0% of producing intervals.
The site produced power but the irradiance sensor reported nothing.
recommended_actions: Clean the plane-of-array pyranometer and check its level and tilt alignment
Cross-check its readings against a second on-site sensor or satellite irradiance
Recalibrate or replace the sensor if the offset persists
Treat performance numbers for this window as unreliable until fixed
safety_notes: Follow site lockout/tagout and arc-flash procedures before opening any DC or AC enclosure.

title: Farm Solar Array: irradiance sensor fault (2024-10-29 to 2024-11-02)
summary: Irradiance sensor fault detected at Farm Solar Array (Arbuckle, CA) over 5 day(s), 2024-10-29 to 2024-11-02.
evidence: Performance index fell from 0.95 in the two weeks before to a median of 1.08 during the event (1.00 = healthy).
Output is above what the measured irradiance allows, so the irradiance sensor is most likely reading low (dirty, drifting or misaligned).
